title: Two Hundred Unsent Letters
subtitle: 价值观 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）
meta: 主题语境：价值观（做人与做事·价值观与人生意义）　|　核心词汇：purpose　|　正文 377 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 purpose 的含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: After my grandmother died we found two hundred letters in a tin, none of them posted. The ① purpose of a letter, I had always assumed, is to arrive; hers were written to be kept, which is a different ② purpose and, I now think, a more honest one. She wrote to my grandfather for eleven years after he stopped being able to read, and I do not believe she ever once expected an answer.

I read them over a winter. Their ③ purpose was not to record anything — the news in them is thin and repeated — but to keep a habit upright, and the purpose of the habit was the habit itself. There is a ④ purposefulness in them that I have never managed in my own work: she sat down at four o'clock, she wrote for twenty minutes, and she stopped. Nothing in the tin was written ⑤ on purpose to be found, and everything in it was written to be found.

The letters changed what I thought usefulness meant. A thing can be ⑥ to no purpose and still not be wasted: two hundred sheets of paper, forty hours of an old woman's afternoons, and not one fact that survives her. What survives is the shape of the ⑦ purpose — the four o'clock, the twenty minutes — and that shape has done more for me than any advice I was ever given.

In March I tried it myself, badly and for six weeks. I wrote to nobody in particular, in a notebook, at four, for twenty minutes. It was ⑧ to good purpose, in the sense that I stopped lying to myself about what I wanted; it was useless in every other sense. I gave up in April and have never quite decided whether that was failure or the ⑨ purpose of the exercise.

The tin is on my desk now. ⑩ For the purpose of this account, I should say that I have kept every letter and read perhaps sixty. People ask, kindly, what the point was. I have stopped answering that question with a point. Purpose, I have learned, is not the same as a point; a point is what you can defend, and a purpose is only what you are willing to go on doing at four o'clock.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请将对应义项填入表中。
options: B. n. 用途；作用；效果
C. n. 决心；意志；坚定
D. 固定搭配：on purpose 故意地；有意地
E. 固定搭配：to no purpose 徒劳地；毫无结果地
F. 固定搭配：to good purpose 有效地；有成效地
G. 固定搭配：for the purpose of 为了……起见；就……而言
H. n. 目标感；意义的所在（the shape of one's purpose）

items.q: Their purpose was not to record anything
There is a purposefulness in them
Nothing in the tin was written on purpose to be found
A thing can be to no purpose
For the purpose of this account

answers.why: 指一封信的“用途、作用”——收信人收到；与祖母“为留存而写”的用途相对。
同样是“用途”，指为保存而写这一不同的作用。
指写作的“目的、意图”：不在于记录什么。
purposefulness 意为“坚定、有目的性”，指她四点钟准时动笔的自律。
on purpose 意为“故意地”，说没有一封信是存心写给后人发现的。
to no purpose 意为“徒劳地、没有结果”，但作者紧接着说这不等于浪费。
指“目标感、意义的形状”，说留下来的正是四点钟那二十分钟的形状。
to good purpose 意为“有成效地”，说这次尝试至少让自己不再自欺。
指这件事本身的“目的”，作者说不清放弃是失败还是目的所在。
for the purpose of 意为“就……而言”，用于说明这份记述的范围。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 一封信的用途是被人收到。（purpose）
它们的意图不在于记录什么。（purpose）
里面没有一样东西是存心写给后人发现的。（on purpose）
一件事可以毫无结果，却仍然不算浪费。（to no purpose）
这次尝试至少在这一点上是有成效的。（to good purpose）
就这份记述而言，我保存了每一封信。（for the purpose of）
answers: The purpose of a letter is to arrive.
Their purpose was not to record anything.
Nothing in the tin was written on purpose to be found.
A thing can be to no purpose and still not be wasted.
The attempt was to good purpose in at least one respect.
For the purpose of this account, I have kept every letter.
